outlook.statement: The Company is evaluating opportunities to establish its presence within India's evolving digital financial ecosystem through initiatives such as Payment Gateway services, Payment Switch infrastructure and, subject to obtaining all applicable statutory, regulatory and licensing approvals, a Payment Bank. Commercial implementation will be undertaken only after obtaining requisite approvals from concerned regulatory authorities.

The Company remains committed to disciplined, responsible and sustainable growth through innovation, prudent governance and regulatory discipline. The initiatives undertaken during the year have established a robust platform for the Company's future expansion while reinforcing its commitment to creating enduring value for shareholders and other stakeholders.

Will continue to evaluate opportunities within the digital financial services ecosystem through initiatives such as Payment Gateway services, Payment Switch infrastructure and, subject to obtaining all applicable statutory, regulatory and licensing approvals, a Payment Bank.
Priorities will continue to focus on disciplined implementation, digital innovation, regulatory responsibility and sustainable long-term value creation.
